name: Cracked Glass
desc: A pane of glass drops in between the audience and the scene and starts quietly failing — impacts arrive one at a time and bloom rather than bang, their radials creeping outward and arresting ragged, a milky bruise spreading around each strike, concentric rings bowing in behind the tips and a glint crawling slowly out along one crack while the oldest damage anneals away.

energy.doc: crack weight, specular lip and glint brightness — max drives thick bright fractures

scale.doc: how far the cracks reach from each impact — max throws them right across the frame

speed.doc: crack-tip creep rate and how often a fresh impact arrives (0.2 still visibly propagates)

density.doc: how many impacts live at once (1-5) and how many radials each throws — keep low to stay polite over a scene

bruise.doc: the milky halo of pulverised glass around each strike — the thing that makes it read as glass rather than scratches

hue.doc: tint of the glass and its specular lip

x.doc: horizontal centre of the impact cluster

y.doc: vertical centre of the impact cluster

style.doc: aesthetic: clean glass with cool specular lips / laminated windscreen gone milky and dense / pale cyan feathered frost crazing / warm dry-brush ink lines / pure cyan hairline schematic of the fracture net, no bruise and no glass at all

seed.doc: deterministic seed for impact placement, radial count and tip wander

alpha.doc: layer opacity — defaults low so the scene behind stays legible
